evidence.title: Agility Robotics to Livestream Analyst & Investor Day Today
evidence.excerpt: SALEM, Ore., October 6, 2026 - Agility Robotics , a leading humanoid robotics and physical AI company, will host its Analyst & Investor Day today, beginning at 12:30 p.m. ET in New York City. The event will be livestreamed and available to investors, analysts, media and the public through Agility’s investor relations website . In addition to presentations from Agility’s leadership team, the event will feature perspectives from leaders across Agility’s customer, manufacturing and broader robotics ecosystem including: Schaeffler - David Kerr, President, Humanoid Robotics and Courtney Baines, Advanced Technology Production Engineer Foxconn - Nelson Hsieh, Director, Central Strategic Investment Department AUVSI - Heather Lee, Acting President and CEO (Association for Uncrewed Vehicle Systems International) The event comes at a significant period of momentum for Agility as the company advances the commercial deployment and scale of humanoid robotics. In September, Agility unveiled Digit 5 , its next-generation humanoid robot engineered for cooperatively safe work at scale.
